svg.title: Area between y = 6 − x² and y = x with one vertical rectangle
svg.desc: The region between the parabola y = 6 − x² (crimson, on top) and the line y = x (blue, on the bottom) is shaded from x = −3 to x = 2, where the curves cross at (−3, −3) and (2, 2). One thin vertical rectangle of width Δx stands in the region; its height is top minus bottom, (6 − x²) − x. A side panel builds the area: solve 6 − x² = x for the limits −3 and 2, then A = the integral from −3 to 2 of [(6 − x²) − x] dx = 125/6, about 20.83.
svg.text: Add them up from the left
